invariants.rationale: Ensures the method is not called with a null list of keys, a common precondition in collection-based mutators.
Write operations typically require a valid, non-empty timestamp; this expresses that precondition.
A delete operation with an empty set might be a no-op; this invariant suggests keys should usually be non-empty.
Validates that every HoodieKey in the keys list is non-null, preventing NPEs on downstream method calls.
